primaryObjective: Correct warm agent turns per second

config.note: Both comparison phases use this same precision and KV capacity. FP8 is experimental; not a BF16 quality-equivalence claim.

power.timingUse: Correctness only; battery operation authorized. Not a comparable performance benchmark.
power.msiMode: Eco Mode and Energy Saver (last user-reported mode)
power.externalPower: 100 W USB-C supply (user reported; connection state monitored separately)
power.note: Windows PowerLineStatus Online indicates external power. It does not measure USB-C negotiated power or system draw.

limitations: Samples are periodic and fields are collected sequentially, not atomically.
Guest memory is within host memory; do not add guest and Windows totals.
Reported GPU unused memory is not a guarantee of successful allocation.
Guest Cached includes file cache; this capture cannot attribute it to PLE versus other files.
No per-process PSS or PyTorch reserved/allocated breakdown was recorded.
